description: 三篇示例文章，每篇一张 AI 原创情境插画、一张可复用的网络图片。

images.description: 原创 AI 情境插画，不是实拍、真实系统截图或作者个人经历的还原。
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide landscape editorial illustration for the Chinese blog essay 'Interfaces as epistemic partners', target 16:9, roughly 1440 pixels wide.
Primary request: depict a digital interface as a place where an anonymous adult researcher can compare evidence and revise a question. A quiet desk near a window, a laptop viewed obliquely, several small physical paper evidence cards and two lightly transparent abstract interface panels echoing those cards. The person, seen from behind and occupying only a small part of the scene, gently repositions one card to explore a different explanation; the composition suggests an open path of inquiry instead of a single final answer.
Style/medium: refined editorial gouache and colored pencil on warm lightly textured ivory paper, painterly rather than corporate vector.
Composition: spacious horizontal framing, clear hierarchy, restrained detail and breathing room; the relationship between papers, person and screen is the focal point. Consistent with a thoughtful personal research blog.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, quiet curiosity, provisional and open.
Color palette: slate blue, muted teal, warm ivory, tiny amber accent.
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no equations, no legible code, no branding, no identifiable person or institution; any marks on paper/screens are sparse abstract line shapes. A conceptual illustration, not a screenshot or research result.
Avoid: robots, glowing brains, sci-fi hologram spectacle, generic corporate vector people, glossy 3D, neon, decorative border, watermark.
